purpose: One more-data-only identity-head pilot; same features/thresholds/augmentation as v1
encoder: torchvision ResNet18 IMAGENET1K_V1, frozen, full crop letterboxed to 224 pixels
features: Equal-weight L2-normalized ResNet18 embedding and spatial HSV histogram
head: One-vs-rest ridge regression to one-hot targets; intercept included and regularized
augmentation: Original plus horizontal flip, each with brightness 0.8/1.0/1.2; deterministic
unknown_policy: Reject absent-roster classes, unknown class, weak score/margin and duplicate team claims
selection_policy: Same head/features/thresholds as v1; no sweep. QM3 90–110s and QM13 90–110s are now regression checks because v1 outcomes are known. Evaluate freshly frozen QM3 120–140s nine-checkpoint set once after training; no tuning on its outcomes.
